title: Decision: mimi-mls has its own strict MediaTypeList decoder
description: Chosen by Mark 2026-11-04. mls-extensions-11 §5.1 needs a MediaTypeList decoder in mimi-mls for content_media_types updates; the crate map forbids mimi-mls depending on mimi-room-policy, so mimi-mls gets its own small strict decoder (crate map unchanged).
